articulation.label: now
articulation.alt: now: /n/ → /aʊ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue; round the lips.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
